dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, can you help me with the menu?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈhɛlp miː wɪð ðə ˈmɛnjuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. This is steamed fish with lime, served with rice.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ðɪs ɪz ˈstiːmd ˈfɪʃ wɪð ˈlaɪm, ˈsɜːrvd wɪð ˈraɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It is. And this is grilled chicken, served with a spicy sauce.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪz. ənd ðɪs ɪz ˈɡrɪld ˈtʃɪkən, ˈsɜːrvd wɪð ə ˈspaɪsi ˈsɔːs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's delicious. Look: roast duck, served with noodles or rice.
dialogue.reading: ɪts dɪˈlɪʃəs. ˈlʊk: ˈroʊst ˈdʌk, ˈsɜːrvd wɪð ˈnuːdəlz ɔːr ˈraɪs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then I'll have the roast duck with rice. What about you?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈhæv ðə ˈroʊst ˈdʌk wɪð ˈraɪs. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ˈstɜːr ˌfraɪd ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz ənd ˈfraɪd ˈfɪʃ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a lot of fried food!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfraɪd ˈfuːd!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. But I'm very hungry tonight!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. bʌt aɪm ˈvɛri ˈhʌŋɡri təˈnaɪt!
